addition.item: Image source option: pick images manually or show all images from a folder below /images (max. 30).

fix.item: Ribbon arrows now work on screens below 768 px.
Fixed a JavaScript error on small screens that stopped further ribbons on the page from working.
The module renders nothing instead of an empty carousel when no images are available.
Update server now offers updates on Joomla 6.

security.item: Image URLs and layout settings are escaped in the output; the item ratio and number of visible items are validated.

change.item: Update server, download and changelog URLs point at TLWebdesignNL/Pretty-PhotoRibbon.

addition.item: Introduced configurable autoplay behaviour for the ribbon carousel.
Published a changelog file for the module package.

change.item: Raised the maximum number of ribbon images from 20 to 30.
Aligned the module dispatcher and helper factories with the TLWeb namespace structure.

fix.item: General stability improvements and dependency updates.
Resolved issues reported after the initial Joomla 4 release.

addition.item: First public version of Pretty PhotoRibbon for Joomla.
